text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
AUSTRALIA, Dec 9 - COAL - QUEENSLAND - Abbot Point - Berth vacant, 5 vessels due by 20/12, no delays.
Dalrymple Bay - Two vessels loading, 3 waiting, 10 due by 22/12. Approx. 2-3 days delay.

Hay Point - BHP advise that there will be a total power outage on both berths from 0700 hours 11/12 to p.m. 14/12 or a.m. 15/12. No shiploading during this period. Two vessels loading, 10 due by 21/12.
Gladstone - No ships loading 25/12.
R.G. Tanna - 2 Vessels loading, 2 waiting, 22 due by 20/1/97. Approx. 1-2 days delay.
Gladstone - No shiploading 25/12.
Barney Point - Berth vacant, 6 vessels due by 16/1/97, no delays.
Brisbane - Shutdown from 1500 hours 24/12 to 1100 hours 26/12. Berth vacant, 1 vessel due 29/12, no delays.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Linesman stoppage from 0000 hours 25/12 to 0800 hours 26/12. Terminal subject to volunteers.
Kooragang - 2 Vessels loading, 2 waiting, 19 due by 23/12/. Approx. 2-3 days delay.
Channel - 2 Vessels loading, 5 waiting, 16 due by 22/12. Approx. 3-4 days delay.
Port Kembla - Shutdown from 0700 hours 25/12 to 0700 hours 26/12. Berth vacant, 19 vessels due by 15/1/97, no delays.
IRON ORE - WESTERN AUSTRIA - Port Hedland - Shutdown from 2359 24/12 to 2359 26/12.
Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) - Berth a - 1 Vessel berthed, 6 due by 18/12. Berth b - 1 Vessel loading, 1 anchored, 6 due by 17/12, 2 others due with no eta.

Dampier - Normal working over christmas.
Parker Point - 1 Vessel loading, berth maintenance. 2 Vessels due by 14/12.
E.I. Island - 1 Vessel loading, 2 anchored, 2 due by 11/12, 16 vessels for Dampier lineup.
